scope: Independent Nebraska noncustodial subsection (2) review with direct inspection of all ten original central raster PNGs from run 34575624396. Exact current bytes and raster pin verified; all fifteen obligations measured. No packet files changed.

ROUTE_IDENTITY.finding: The route is the registry's subsection (2) probation/fine/community-service track; its exact route key and official-pdf-fill vehicle agree across registry, manifest, field map and wiring. The custodial subsection (3)(b) denial grounds are excluded.

SOURCE_IDENTITY.finding: Four exact source hashes in source-receipt.json match the held sources and current source bindings: CC-6-11 c0dcc5c0…, CC-6-11.2 8bfa884d…, DC-1-15 43675986…, CC-6-11A 615c64b4….

COMPONENT_SET.finding: All six registry component IDs are present in the wiring and output records: primary, proposed order, conditional district notice/service, instructions, conditional fee-waiver treatment and local-rules guidance.

KNOWN_PREFILLS.finding: Actual-writes and field-map records measure 20 held prefill writes across canonical/boundary fixtures; unmatched county and overlong/participant-controlled fields remain explicitly withheld.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.finding: The synchronized guidance carries all 30 required-before-filing items and the registry participant actions; signatures, court completion and service acts remain participant/court work.

ROUTE_OPTIONS.finding: The official CC-6-11 route is fixed by the subsection (2) fact pattern; no custom pleading or custodial denial selection is exposed.

REPEATING_ROWS.finding: The focused completeness reader reports PASS_COMPLETE 20/121 written with incompleteRows 0.

PROTECTED_FIELDS.finding: Source and role policy withholds signature/date, court/prosecutor/clerk/judicial fields, unperformed service certification and other court-owned fields; no protected field is written.

ARTIFACTS.finding: Canonical and boundary outputs are unchanged and rehashed after the de2722201 deferred build; final build and check logs report synchronized output and no raster pages.

PAGE_ORDER.finding: Both five-page fixtures follow the six-component manifest: CC-6-11, CC-6-11.2, DC-1-15 pages 1-2, and CC-6-11A.

CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.finding: Directly viewed all ten original PNG pages (canonical and boundary, five each) from the retained central artifact. Text, form lines and prefilled values are legible; no clipping, overlap, stray ink, or page-boundary defect observed.

FILING_DESTINATION.finding: Guidance directs filing in the existing criminal case with the clerk of the sentencing county or district court.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.finding: No fee is invented; the unresolved fee and non-fitting official waiver form are disclosed as release blockers.

SERVICE.finding: District court service by mail and certificate completion are described; county court clerk scheduling/mailing is distinguished.

SELF_HELP_STOP.finding: All nine exact registry self-help stop conditions are present, including prosecutor opposition, denial/appeal choice, disputed probation, vacatur/firearm/sex-registration/immigration/representation and out-of-state/federal/tribal matters.

nineCounters.counterNote: All nine counters directly measured: eight nonvisual counters zero from focused completeness/field proofs and visualDefects zero from direct inspection of all ten original central PNG pages.
